_comment: Descriptions keyed "<table>/<full plain label, newlines as spaces>"; consumed by gen_menus.py. Repeated-label rows (MARKER %d, Empty %d, %s) share one entry.
menu_top/DISPLAY: Traces, formats, channel, scale, time-domain transform, IF bandwidth, smoothing.
menu_top/MARKER: Select, search, track and use markers.
menu_top/STIMULUS: Sweep range, points, jog step, output mute.
menu_top/CALIBRATE: Calibration procedure, slots, apply/reset, enhanced response.
menu_top/RECALL: Recall a calibration slot 0–6 or load a .cal from the SD card.
menu_top/MEASURE: Built-in calculation panels (L/C match, cable, resonance, SWR BW, tune, LC, crystal, filter).
menu_top/SD CARD: Save and load Touchstone, screenshot and calibration files; file naming and format.
menu_top/CONFIG: Touch calibration, expert settings, save config, USB/serial connection, version, brightness (H4), clock.
menu_top/%s SWEEP: PAUSE SWEEP freezes the display and source at the last point; the button then reads RESUME SWEEP.
menu_display/TRACE: Turn traces 0–3 on/off and choose the active trace.
menu_display/FORMAT S11 (REFL): Set the active trace to a reflection (S11) format and channel.
menu_display/FORMAT S21 (THRU): Set the active trace to a transmission (S21) format and channel.
menu_display/CHANNEL %s: Toggle the active trace between S11 (REFL) and S21 (THRU).
menu_display/SCALE: Scale, reference position, auto scale, electrical delay, S21 offset, grid options, ham bands.
menu_display/IF BANDWIDTH %uHz: Receiver bandwidth per point: narrower = quieter and slower (4000 … 30 Hz).
menu_display/DATA SMOOTH: Smoothing of the sweep data before display.
menu_trace/TRACE %d: Enable/disable this trace; enabling makes it the active trace. The button shows its channel and format.
menu_trace/%s TRACE: Shows the active trace's channel and format; press to hide the active trace (the label reads with the current state).
menu_formatS11/SMITH: Smith chart; press again on a Smith trace to choose the marker readout.
menu_swr_ant/SWR ANT: SWR at the antenna end of the feedline, corrected for the one-way cable loss entered under CABLE LOSS (or computed from CABLE TYPE and CABLE LENGTH on the H4). Blank until a loss is set.
menu_swr_ant/CABLE LOSS %b.3FdB: One-way matched loss of the feedline in dB at the band in use; feeds SWR ANT. Entering a value selects CABLE TYPE = MANUAL.
menu_swr_ant/CABLE TYPE %s: Coax preset (LMR-400, RG-213, RG-8X, RG-58, RG-174/316) used with CABLE LENGTH to compute the loss for SWR ANT; MANUAL uses the CABLE LOSS value.
menu_swr_ant/CABLE LENGTH: Cable length in metres for the coax preset (shared with MEASURE → CABLE).
menu_formatS11/RESISTANCE: Series resistance R of Z = R + jX, ohms.
menu_formatS11/REACTANCE: Series reactance X, ohms (negative capacitive, positive inductive).
menu_formatS11/› MORE: More S11 formats (polar, linear, real/imag, Q, admittance, L/C equivalents).
menu_format2/CONDUCTANCE: G of the admittance Y = G + jB, siemens.
menu_format2/SUSCEPTANCE: B of Y = G + jB, siemens.
menu_format2/› MORE: More S11 formats (Z phase, series/parallel L, C, R).
menu_formatS21/SMITH: Smith chart of S21; press again to choose the marker readout.
menu_format4/SERIES R: Resistance of a device in series between the ports.
menu_format4/SERIES X: Reactance of a device in series between the ports.
menu_format4/SERIES |Z|: Impedance magnitude of a device in series between the ports.
menu_format4/SHUNT R: Resistance of a device shunting the through path.
menu_format4/SHUNT |Z|: Impedance magnitude of a shunt device.
menu_format4/Q FACTOR: |X| / R from the S21 series/shunt measurement.
menu_marker_s11smith/%s: Marker readout format for an S11 Smith trace (LIN, LOG, Re+Im, R+jX, R+L/C, G+jB, G+L/C, Rp+jXp, Rp+L/C).
menu_marker_s21smith/%s: Marker readout format for an S21 Smith trace (LIN, LOG, Re+Im, shunt or series R+jX / R+L/C).
menu_scale/TRACE: Choose which trace the scale settings apply to.
menu_scale/AUTO SCALE: Fit the active trace's current data to the grid.
menu_scale/TOP: Enter the value at the top grid line.
menu_scale/BOTTOM: Enter the value at the bottom grid line.
menu_scale/REF POSITION: Grid line (0 bottom … 8 top) that carries the reference value.
menu_scale/E-DELAY: Electrical delay for the active channel, seconds.
menu_scale/S21 OFFSET %b.3FdB: dB offset added to S21 (e.g. an external attenuator's value).
menu_scale/SHOW GRID VALUES: Print each grid line's value at the right edge.
menu_scale/HAM BANDS %s: Amateur band indicator region (OFF, IARU R1/R2/R3, USA, CANADA, UK, GERMANY, JAPAN, AUSTRALIA).
menu_ham_bands/%s: Select the region whose band edges are marked on the frequency axis; OFF hides the indicator.
menu_transform/LOW PASS IMPULSE: Impulse response (needs a sweep starting near 0 Hz).
menu_transform/LOW PASS STEP: Step response (needs a sweep starting near 0 Hz).
menu_transform/WINDOW %s: Window function: MINIMUM, NORMAL or MAXIMUM side-lobe suppression.
menu_transform/VELOCITY F. %d%%%%: Cable velocity factor in percent, for the distance axis.
menu_marker/SELECT MARKER: Turn markers 1–8 on/off, all off, delta readout.
menu_marker/SEARCH %s: Cycle the search mode (MAXIMUM, MINIMUM, ZERO) and move the active marker to it.
menu_marker/SEARCH ‹LEFT: Move the active marker to the next feature to the left.
menu_marker/SEARCH ›RIGHT: Move the active marker to the next feature to the right.
menu_marker/TRACKING: Repeat the search after every sweep.
menu_marker_sel/MARKER %d: Enable this marker and make it active; press again while active to turn it off.
menu_marker_sel/DELTA: Show every marker relative to the active marker.
menu_marker_ops/› SPAN: Two markers: start/stop from them; one marker: span so the marker sits on the sweep edge.
menu_marker_ops/› E-DELAY: Add the group delay at the marker to the electrical delay.
menu_stimulus/FREQ STEP %bFHz: Point spacing; entering a value moves STOP so the points fall on it.
menu_stimulus/JOG STEP AUTO: Wheel step in the frequency lever modes (AUTO = decade-rounded, or a fixed step).
menu_stimulus/SWEEP POINTS %u: Number of sweep points (51 … 401 on the H4, 51/101 on the H).
menu_stimulus/MUTE OUTPUT ON PAUSE: Disable the signal generator's outputs while the sweep is paused (fork).
menu_cal/CALIBRATE: Collect the standards (OPEN, SHORT, LOAD, ISOLN, THRU) and finish with DONE.
menu_cal/POWER AUTO: Source drive level the calibration is made at: AUTO or 2/4/6/8 mA.
menu_cal/SAVE: Save the calibration and setup to a slot 0–6 or to the SD card.
menu_cal/RANGE: Shows the calibrated range and points; press to return the sweep (and power) to it.
menu_cal/RESET: Discard the current calibration (slots are untouched).
menu_cal/APPLY: Switch the correction off/on without discarding it.
menu_cal/ENHANCED RESPONSE: Correct S21 for source mismatch using the corrected S11.
menu_calop/OPEN: Measure the OPEN standard on CH0.
menu_calop/SHORT: Measure the SHORT standard on CH0.
menu_calop/LOAD: Measure the LOAD standard on CH0.
menu_calop/THRU: Measure the through connection CH0 → CH1.
menu_calop/DONE: Compute the correction, apply it, and open the SAVE menu.
menu_calop/DONE IN RAM: Compute and apply the correction without saving (status shows C*).
menu_save/SAVE TO SD CARD: Write the calibration and setup as a .cal file.
menu_save/Empty %d: Save to this slot; the label shows the slot's range once used.
menu_recall/LOAD FROM SD CARD: Load a .cal file from the SD card.
menu_measure/L/C MATCH: L-network to match the marker impedance to 50 Ω.
menu_measure/CABLE (S11): Length/VF, Z0 and loss of an open-ended cable.
menu_measure/RESONANCE (S11): Frequencies where X crosses zero, with R + jX.
menu_measure/SWR BW (S11): Bandwidth and Q of the SWR dip nearest the active marker (fork).
menu_measure/SHUNT LC (S21): L, C, R, Q of a resonator shunting the through path.
menu_measure/SERIES LC (S21): L, C, R, Q of a resonator in series with the through path.
menu_measure/SERIES XTAL (S21): Crystal motional parameters and parallel resonance.
menu_measure/FILTER (S21): Centre, −3/−6 dB bandwidths, Q, roll-off of a filter.
menu_measure/› MORE (S21): Second page: the S21 through-path panels (shunt/series LC, crystal, filter). Selecting one replaces the page with that panel's submenu, so BACK returns to page 1.
menu_measure_s21_page/SHUNT LC (S21): L, C, R, Q of a resonator shunting the through path.
menu_measure_s21_page/SERIES LC (S21): L, C, R, Q of a resonator in series with the through path.
menu_measure_s21_page/SERIES XTAL (S21): Crystal motional parameters and parallel resonance.
menu_measure_s21_page/FILTER (S21): Centre, −3/−6 dB bandwidths, Q, roll-off of a filter.
menu_measure_s21_page/CHOKE (S21): Common-mode choke workflow: per-band series resistance against a stored fixture null (fork).
menu_measure/TUNE (S11): Antenna-tuning workflow: target frequency, ADD/REMOVE wire verdict, sensitivity against a stored reference (fork).
menu_measure_lc/L/C MATCH: Recompute the L/C match at the marker.
menu_measure_s21/Rl = %b.4FΩ: Load resistance assumed for the series/shunt calculation (normally 50 Ω).
menu_measure_cable/VELOCITY F. %d%%%%: Velocity factor used to convert electrical to physical length.
menu_measure_cable/CABLE LENGTH: Enter the real length in metres to have the panel report the cable's VF instead.
menu_measure_resonance/STORE REF: Store the current sweep as the reference for the REF Δf0 row and REPEAT CHECK (fork).
menu_measure_resonance/REPEAT CHECK: Message box: maximum |ΔΓ| between the stored reference and the current sweep, a repeatability check (fork).
menu_measure_swr_bw/SWR BW (S11): Bandwidth and Q of the SWR dip nearest the active marker: f0, minimum SWR, 2:1 and 3:1 edge frequencies, Q (Yaghjian & Best, using the measured R at the dip).
menu_measure_tune/TUNE (S11): Target frequency, ADD/REMOVE wire verdict, assumed or measured sensitivity, and the reference Δf0 row.
menu_measure_tune/ANTENNA: Cycle the assumed antenna type: UNKNOWN, DIPOLE, VERTICAL, EFHW.
menu_measure_tune/WIRE CHANGE: Enter the wire length added (+) or removed (−) since STORE REF, in metres; per leg on a dipole.
menu_measure_tune/STORE REF: Store the current sweep as the reference for measured sensitivity and REPEAT CHECK.
menu_measure_tune/REPEAT CHECK: Message box: maximum |ΔΓ| between the stored reference and the current sweep, a repeatability check.
menu_measure_choke/CHOKE (S21): Series-through choke test: per-band series R and X, a verdict against the target, the jig ceiling and any parallel resonance.
menu_measure_choke/TARGET R_S %b.2FΩ: Target common-mode series resistance in ohms (default 5 k, minimum 2 k).
menu_measure_choke/FIXTURE none: Store the current S21 sweep of the OPEN test jig as the fixture null de-embedded from every reading; shows none or set.
menu_sdcard/LOAD: Open the file browser (screenshot, S1P, S2P, CAL).
menu_sdcard/SAVE S1P: Save S11 as a Touchstone .s1p file.
menu_sdcard/SAVE S2P: Save S11 and S21 as a Touchstone .s2p file.
menu_sdcard/SCREENSHOT: Save the screen as an image (format per IMAGE FORMAT).
menu_sdcard/SAVE CALIBRATION: Save the calibration and setup as a .cal file.
menu_sdcard/AUTO NAME: Name files from the clock instead of asking for a name.
menu_sdcard/IMAGE FORMAT %s: Screenshot format. H4: cycles BMP, TIFF, PNG (indexed 8-bit, compressed; opens anywhere and is much smaller than BMP). H: BMP or TIFF. The choice is saved with the configuration.
menu_sdcard_browse/LOAD CAL: Load a saved calibration (live, unbound to a slot).
menu_config/TOUCH CAL: Calibrate the touch panel (press the shown targets).
menu_config/TOUCH TEST: Draw where the panel senses a touch, to check the calibration.
menu_config/EXPERT SETTINGS: Harmonic threshold, TCXO, battery offset, IF offset, remember state, flip, DFU, more.
menu_config/SAVE CONFIG: Save the device configuration to flash.
menu_config/CONNECTION: USB or serial console and the serial speed.
menu_config/VERSION: Firmware version, build, board, serial, clock and battery (the About screen).
menu_config/DATE/TIME: Real-time clock: set date and time, calibrate the RTC.
menu_device/THRESHOLD %.6q: Frequency above which harmonic mode is used.
menu_device/TCXO %.6q: Reference oscillator frequency (correct it to trim the frequency scale).
menu_device/VBAT OFFSET %umV: Correction added to the battery voltage reading.
menu_device/REMEMBER STATE: Restore the last sweep/trace setup at power-up instead of slot 0's.
menu_device/›DFU: Reboot into the USB bootloader for a firmware update.
menu_device/› MORE: More expert settings: frequency mode, digit separator, USB UID, firmware dump, scripts, clear config.
menu_dfu/RESET AND ENTER DFU: Reboot into DFU mode (screen goes blank; flash with dfu-util or DfuSe).
menu_device1/MODE %s: Sweep frequency mode shown on the frequency line: START/STOP or CENTER/SPAN.
menu_device1/SEPARATOR %s: Thousands separator style for displayed frequencies.
menu_device1/USB DEVICE UID: Give the USB device a unique serial so several NanoVNAs can be told apart.
menu_device1/DUMP FIRMWARE: Write the running firmware image to the SD card as a .bin.
menu_device1/LOAD COMMAND SCRIPT: Run a .cmd/.nvs command script from the SD card.
menu_device1/CLEAR CONFIG: Erase the saved configuration (and calibration slots) — asks for confirmation.
menu_clear/CLEAR ALL AND RESET: Erase configuration and slots and reboot.
menu_connection/CONNECTION %s: Console over USB or over the serial (UART) header.
menu_rtc/SET DATE: Set the clock's date (used for auto file names).
menu_rtc/RTC CAL %+b.3fppm: Trim the real-time clock rate in ppm.
menu_rtc/RTC 512Hz Led2 %s: Output the RTC's 512 Hz calibration signal on LED2, for trimming with a counter.
menu_sdcard_browse/GUIDE: Open a guide from the card's GUIDES folder (.md or .txt) in the paged viewer: wheel or tap the right/left half of the screen turns pages, push the wheel or tap the header returns to the browser. Chapter 7 describes the format.
menu_formatS11/› SWR ANT: Submenu: the SWR ANT format and its feedline settings (CABLE LOSS; CABLE TYPE and CABLE LENGTH on the H4).
